SELECT ppcd.sku_id, ppcd.sku_no, ppcd.delivery_day, ppcd.min_qty, ppcd.max_qty, ppcd.currency, ppcd.tax_price, ppcd.tax_rate, ppcd.disabled, ppcd.effective_date, ppcd.expire_date, pp.code as CJJMCode, ppcd.purchase_price_detail_id, ppcd.purchase_price_change_id, ppcd.supplier_id FROM purchase_price_change_detail ppcd left join purchase_price_detail ppd on ppcd.purchase_price_detail_id = ppd.id and ppd.is_deleted = false left join purchase_price pp on pp.id = ppd.purchase_price_id and pp.is_deleted = false
ppcd.is_deleted = false and ppcd.purchase_price_change_id = #{purchasePriceChangeId}

select ppcd.sku_id, ppcd.sku_no, ppcd.delivery_day, ppcd.min_qty, ppcd.max_qty, ppcd.currency, ppcd.tax_price, ppcd.tax_rate, ppcd.disabled, ppcd.effective_date, ppcd.expire_date, ppcd.purchase_price_detail_id, ppcd.purchase_price_change_id, ppcd.supplier_id from purchase_price_change_detail ppcd LEFT JOIN purchase_price_change ppc ON ppcd.purchase_price_change_id = ppc.id AND ppcd.is_deleted = FALSE
ppcd.is_deleted = FALSE and ppc.approve_status = 'approve' and ppcd.purchase_price_detail_id = #{purchasePriceDetailId} and ppcd.id > #{id}
